items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: I met the May Hall, he came to sing

ctx.x: Yeah, you don't see many guys sitting on his tracks with glasses.

Unless he, he, he has to have glasses and he can land glasses all of his life. But now, in California I met some, some great musicians there and we had a tremendous session. I met the May Hall, he came to sing, and Al Morgan, he came to sing. And was, can a man leave? Sam Mason. Sam. And Michael, Michael DeRae was there. In fact, all of the New Orleans musicians that are out in California, they, they came out to, to, and received me and. Shaped my hand and we knew some more of them.
What did you hear of Rene Hall play?
